name: Priyam Sameer
summary: I lead lending products, lender partnerships and P&L at CashKaro. Previously, I worked across agricultural products and commerce at Absolute and founded UrbanKhet.

experience.title: General Manager, Product Management & Business Growth

progression.title: General Manager, Product Management & Business Growth

responsibilities.text: Lead personal and education lending product strategy, lender commercials, operations and P&L. Connect application capture and lender matching with funnel analysis and partner feedback.
Work with engineering and lender partners on eligibility, KYC, application-status and payout handoffs, connecting integration requirements with reconciliation and service-level reviews.

Authored the EduLoans policy/workflow model and scripted interaction prototypes for student intake, partner review and human document verification: 62 rules, eight lender configurations and 23 workflow states.
Explored a separate MCP policy-service proposal for shared evaluation and reviewed feedback. Coordinate cross-functional priorities, participate in hiring and negotiate with partners.

experience.companyDescription: Finance software, working capital and payments for MSMEs.
experience.title: Senior Product Manager

responsibilities.text: Worked on the KuberX launch and go-to-market plan, connecting acquisition, onboarding and activation with SME product economics.
On Pay via Credit Card, connected the SME customer offer with payment infrastructure and operating handoffs, working with engineering and go-to-market teams.

experience.companyDescription: Bioscience, agricultural data, farmer products and commodity commerce.
experience.title: Principal Product Manager

responsibilities.text: Led SilkRoute product work from trader discovery through negotiation, ordering and settlement, working with regional teams on a connected commodity-trading system. The programme reported $100M GMV within nine months; this is transaction value, not platform revenue.
Led lender-facing agricultural risk product work and contributed to adapting information exchange for ULI. Explored a separate ONDC credit proposal; lenders retained credit decisions.
Reshaped Upaj around farm monitoring, market information, content and timely notifications. Worked with engineering and agronomy on crop-health guidance, monitoring and rainfall-insurance workflows.
Coordinated product, engineering, data, agronomy, finance, operations and regional teams, including adaptation for Brazil and Malaysia and institutional-commerce requirements.

experience.companyDescription: Farm-to-customer produce venture for households and business buyers.
experience.title: Founder & Director

responsibilities.text: Founded the venture and owned the customer offer, web product, farmer relationships, acquisition, fulfilment and business economics.
Built the sourcing and decentralised-delivery model, reworked fulfilment during COVID as constraints changed, then wound down the venture after the second wave.

ventureSupport.text: UrbanKhet received incubation, seed support and innovation-grant backing through IIMA Ventures/CIIE.CO and GUSEC, including TIDE 2.0 and Gujarat SSIP.
